covers: Vitest setup and conventions, deploy script, env-file discipline, production topology.

testing.environment: node (not jsdom) — tests exercise pure functions/route-handler logic, not DOM rendering
testing.include_glob: src/**/*.test.ts ONLY — .tsx test files would NOT be picked up under current config
testing.convention: tests are co-located next to source, e.g. src/lib/session.test.ts, src/app/checkout/checkout-flow.test.ts, src/app/bff/auth/social-routes.test.ts
testing.known_flaky_baseline_as_of_2026-08-13: 221 passing, 4 pre-existing failures (landing.test.ts x3, hero-package-search.test.ts x1) confirmed unrelated to recent changes by stashing and re-running clean (f026) — if these 4 still fail, that's expected baseline noise, not a new regression; if a DIFFERENT test fails, that's real

deployment.script: update.sh at repo root — pulls via git and builds ON the server (not a CI artifact push)
deployment.prod_bind: Next process listens on 127.0.0.1:3020, nginx reverse-proxies esim.uplisoft.com to it

env_file_discipline..env.production: COMMITTED to git on purpose — contains only NEXT_PUBLIC_* values, which are public once bundled into client JS anyway; comment in the file itself explains this
env_file_discipline..env.local: gitignored, wins locally over .env.production, NEVER exists on the server
env_file_discipline.consequence: any env var an engineer only sets in .env.local silently does not exist in production after `update.sh` — this exact gap made the Google sign-in button fail to render in prod until .env.production/.env.example were added (f029)

deployment.nginx_api_carveout: nginx proxies ALL of /api/* to the Express backend; this is why browser-facing Next route handlers live under /bff/** instead — see topics/backend-integration.json

type_checking: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit (no dedicated script in package.json, run manually per session logs); tsconfig.tsbuildinfo is a generated incremental cache, never read/edit it directly.
